summary: Brother of John's 3rd-great-grandfather Andrew H. Heffernan.
bio: Baptized 29 Aug 1852; DL&W railroad brakeman; died at Wilkes-Barre 16 Nov 1904. His obituary (W-B Times 17 Nov 1904) calls him 'for the past forty years a resident of this valley', and the 1900 census gives his immigration as 1866 - the basis for dating the family's emigration to c.1864-66.
sources: Michael Dwyer, Heffernans of Slieveardagh (Welsh Hill Press, 2020), Branch 4 (and Branch 3), working from the Killenaule and Gortnahoe Catholic parish registers: https://archive.org/details/heffernans-of-slieveardagh (citing Wilkes-Barre Times 17 Nov 1904)
